authority.rule: Repository evidence freezes BEJEWELY's intended Google Play declaration and store-copy boundary. Play Console acceptance and any regulatory medical-device determination remain external authority.

selectedFeatures.basis: Google Play's Health apps declaration taxonomy explicitly lists skin care under Diseases and Conditions Management. This store taxonomy mapping does not change BEJEWELY's cosmetic product purpose into diagnosis, treatment, or medical-device functionality.

existingGenerationSafetyBoundary.visibleCueOnlyBoundary: Do not infer hydration, barrier state, acne disease, UV damage, or sensitivity beyond cautious visible cues.

storeListingBoundary.englishDisclaimer: BEJEWELY is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. For medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

storeListingBoundary.cameraCompatibilityEnglish: Photo analysis requires a supported device camera. BEJEWELY does not require external medical hardware or a special medical sensor.
